title: Waze adds new AI-powered features and customization updates
slides: Waze just added AI—but what does it change?
It now learns your driving patterns automatically.
The AI suggested a detour I never would have found.
You can now route around rough roads or tolls.
Open Waze, set your preference, and test the difference.
thread_text:
Waze knows where you go.

It silently recorded your driving patterns for days before suggesting its first move.

It spotted a shortcut through back alleys.

The AI found a route that saved 12 minutes simply by learning you never turn left on Sundays.

The detour changed your parking spot.

Now it avoids streets where you usually slow down at 8 AM.

Tolls or potholes: pick your poison.

Set a preference once; the AI reroutes around roughness or cost automatically.

Open Waze and set a new avoidance.

Does your commute still feel the same? Try it and see if the AI betrays your habits.

Waze watched your driving for days before it ever suggested a move. You never even noticed.
